question: were Hilton's misses random or systemic?
answer: the diagnostic returned 10 of 10 publication-grade with zero failures, across 6 sub-brands and 6 cities on the modern host. That is the strongest evidence available that the prior misses were transient.
what_could_not_be_tested: the legacy per-brand host hamptoninn3.hilton.com, which carried one of the two prior NAVIGATION_FAILED results. NO unresolved Hilton row uses that host any more, so the shape could not be re-sampled. Its cause remains a hypothesis rather than a finding.
no_retries_were_run: a failure was never retried to improve the measurement; the diagnostic sampled NEW properties instead.
